description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) DUTY UNTO DEATH (Auric Champions, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test; the Boyz charged (Fights First, so the Ork player selects first in the Custodes' Fight phase) and each Custodian Guard A model has 1 wound left. Pile-ins end; the Ork player real-clicks the Boyz in the fighter list, assigns every attack to Custodian Guard A and confirms in the attack dialog; that targeting opens enemy_targets_unit_fight for P1; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard...' spends 1 CP; the attacks resolve and every destroyed Custodian rolls a D6 — 3+ keeps it fighting (Fight On Death rolls in the dice log).
